enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe regularly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow under head. Pull blanket up to chin. Stretch right leg. Turn to right side. Move left arm. Turn onto back. Move right arm. Turn to left side. Pull blanket down. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Move leg. Turn over. Sleep.
Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating breakfast with tea and cereal
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open fridge. Take out milk. Take out cereal. Take out bowl. Pour cereal. Pour milk. Eat cereal. Drink tea. Put bowl in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting by train and bus to aged-care placement
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to train station. Wait on platform. Board train. Sit on seat. Ride train. Get off train. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Sit on seat. Ride bus. Get off bus. Walk to placement. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Assisting residents and completing social work tasks at aged-care placement
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at placement. Sign in. Put bag in locker. Greet residents. Assist resident with walking. Help resident with eating. Escort resident to activity. Conduct group activity. Take notes. Return to office. Type case notes. Attend meeting. Update records. Check on resident. Assist with phone call.

Walk to staff room. Open bag. Take out lunchbox. Open lunchbox. Take out sandwich. Take out apple. Eat sandwich. Eat apple. Drink water from bottle. Close lunchbox. Put lunchbox in bag. Walk out of staff room.

Assist resident D with personal care. Help resident D to bathroom. Wash hands. Escort resident D to lounge. Conduct one-on-one assessment with resident E. Write notes. Attend case conference. Discuss intervention strategies. Update care plan. Make phone calls to family members. Document calls. Assist resident F with mobility. Walk with resident F in garden. Return to office. Organize files. Prepare reports. Submit reports. Clean desk. Collect belongings. Sign out. Walk to exit.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home by train and bus
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Sit on seat. Ride bus. Get off bus. Walk to train station. Wait on platform. Board train. Sit on seat. Ride train. Get off train. Walk home. Enter house.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open fridge. Take out vegetables. Take out tofu. Close fridge. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir with spatula. Add tofu. Stir. Add sauce. Stir. Turn off stove. Turn off light. Walk out.

Pick up plate. Serve food onto plate. Carry plate to table. Sit at table. Pick up fork. Eat food. Drink water. Finish meal. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Put plate in dishwasher. Walk out.

Turn on tap. Pick up sponge. Add dish soap to sponge. Wash dishes. Rinse dishes. Put dishes on drying rack. Wipe counter with cloth. Turn off tap. Wring out sponge. Put sponge in holder. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying and reviewing placement notes on computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on light. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Log in. Open placement notes. Read notes. Highlight key points. Open textbook. Read chapter. Type summary. Save document. Close laptop. Turn off desk lamp. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet hair. Apply shampoo. Massage scalp. Rinse hair. Apply soap to body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and texting family, looking at photo of dog
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open messaging app. Select family group chat. Type message: 'Hi, how are you?' Send message. Receive reply. Read reply. Type reply: 'Good, just relaxing.' Send reply. Open photo gallery. Scroll to photo of dog. Look at photo. Smile. Put down phone. Lie down on bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and winding down with tea
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Wait for water to boil. Pour hot water into mug. Add tea bag. Walk to bedroom. Turn on light. Sit on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read page. Sip tea. Turn page. Read page. Sip tea. Close book. Put book on nightstand. Pick up mug. Walk to kitchen. Pour out tea. Rinse mug. Put mug in sink. Walk to bedroom. Turn off light. Lie down on bed.

Lie on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Turn to right side. Move arm. Turn onto back. Stretch legs. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket down. Turn to right side. Sleep. Move leg. Turn over. Sleep.
